name: std::wcschr
intro: Finds the first occurrence of the wide character ch in the wide string pointed to by str.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
str

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated wide string to be analyzed


 ch

 -

 wide character to search for

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the found character in str, or a null pointer if no such character is found.

examples.output:
The character \u732b found at position 1
The character \u72ac not found

summary: Finds the first occurrence of the wide character ch in the wide string pointed to by str.
